scope: Read-only independent source/ownership/resource review; no builds, product edits, or new native executions by reviewer.

finding.description: The original legacy_batch copied direct embedding rows before validate_native_batch performed geometry-dependent work/payload bounds.
finding.resolution: Current validate_native_shape is allocation-free, called before any foreign input slice or owned input row in legacy_batch, and retained inside native_plan; regression tests prove oversized shapes fail before missing-input validation and preserve previous outputs.

review_notes: Context owns a distinct borrowed handle backed by Arc<ModelData> and retains an Arc<BertModel>; original owning-handle release does not invalidate live context data.
Encoder/decoder dispatch is explicit. Memory/state/adapter operations require decoder memory; no dummy decoder state is introduced.
Pooled outputs own their vectors. Validation precedes output changes; accepted work clears pooled state and updates mappings, including cancellation behavior.
Classifier optional matrices control bias/activation execution, and source flat extraction stride is handled separately from physical graph width.
Native sequence policy retains measured MSVC/GNU container order and duplicate handling; unsupported target profiles fail explicitly.
Shape limits include token/attention/FFN/pooling work and membership estimates; flash storage and retained C output buffers have separate declared bounds, not one peak-process promise.
qualification: Final full validation v3 was reported running by the package owner and is not asserted complete by this source review.
